articles.title: OpenAI Fires Three Safety Researchers Over Alleged Leak to Outside Group
articles.snippet: OpenAI says the three broke its rules on handling sensitive information. The exits land after months of rogue-agent incidents, a trail of safety-team departures, and a new lawsuit.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Is Here, and Google’s Flagship Tops All Other AI Models on Cybersecurity
articles.snippet: Gemini 4 Argon tops 12 of 18 benchmarks in Google's own table, writes a million tokens per reply and resists hijacking best. Cyber defenders get it first, with the guardrails off.

articles.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Reveals Midterm Endorsements After Clarity Act Collapse
articles.snippet: The Coinbase-backed group's first Senate endorsements—Republicans Jon Husted and Ashley Hinson and Democrat Chris Pappas—come two weeks after the Clarity Act's collapse, as the industry's fight shifts to the campaign trail.
